long_biography.plain_text:
Robert van der Wallen returned to loyalty marketing in 2020 after an attempted BrandLoyalty repurchase stalled. He acquired German and Italian promotion businesses, combined them as L – Founders of Loyalty and built a rival near BrandLoyalty's headquarters. Opportunity Partners later reacquired BrandLoyalty, placing both businesses within the same investment group.

At PSV, his contribution is supervisory rather than operational. He joined the Eindhoven football club's supervisory board in 2016 and became chairman four years later. The board advises and oversees management, while the PSV Football Foundation manages the club company's shares. Van der Wallen describes his role as controlling, motivating and inspiring from a measured distance.

proposed_details.existing_value:
According to Quote, the Dutch businessman Robert van der Wallen has been identified as the client behind the Feadship project 713, a 59.5m vessel. Currently, Mr. van der Wallen is the owner of the 49.8m Heesen yacht named My Loyalty, which was listed for sale in June 2023 with Edmiston's Hans van Doornmalen for €28,500,000 (including VAT).

The Feadship hull 713 was transported to the Koninklijke De Vries shipyard in Aalsmeer in April 2023 for the final stages of construction and outfitting.

Robert van der Wallen amassed his wealth through BrandLoyalty, a marketing company that he sold in 2013, earning him a total of €950 million in multiple installments, as reported by the Dutch newspaper Brabants Dagblad. In February 2023, he reacquired BrandLoyalty for an undisclosed amount. Quote's "rich list" called Quote 500 estimated his net worth at €1.1 billion in their 2022 edition. Additionally, Mr. van der Wallen serves as the Chairman of the Advisory Board for PSV, a football club based in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

In addition to owning luxurious superyachts, Mr. van der Wallen is also the owner of what has been referred to as "the most expensive private jet in the Netherlands," a Bombardier Global 6500. This particular model reportedly starts at around $56 million.
